description:
The full price of one model in rubles — the authoritative answer to "what does this cost".

Prefer this over the pricing embedded in models_list and models_search whenever the model is not billed per token. Those two return "0.00" token rates for such models; only this tool returns `perUnit`, where the real price per image, per second or per thousand characters lives.

For speech models it also lists the voices speech_create accepts (`supportedVoices`), for video models the durations, resolutions and aspect ratios video_create accepts (`video`).

Errors with InvalidParams if the model id is unknown or the model is no longer active.

modelId.description: Exact model id from the catalogue, vendor included, e.g. "openai/gpt-6-astra".

name: models_get_pricing

inputPer1MRub.description: Price of 1M input tokens in rubles, decimal string, e.g. "182.40". "0.00" when unit is not "token".

isFree.description: True only for genuinely free models. Do not infer this from a zero price: models billed per image or per minute also report "0.00" token rates.

outputPer1MRub.description: Price of 1M output tokens in rubles, decimal string. "0.00" when unit is not "token".

perUnit.description: Present only for models not billed per token. This is where their real price lives.

priceRub.description: Price of one unit in rubles, decimal string.

supportedVoices.description: Speech models only: voice names to pass as `voice` to speech_create. Absent when the model has no list.

unit.description: Billing unit. "token" — priced per token, the two Rub fields below are meaningful. "unit" — priced per image, per minute, per character and so on; token fields are "0.00" and the real price is in models_get_pricing → perUnit. "unknown" — no pricing on record.

video.description: Video models only: the values video_create accepts for this model.

aspectRatios.description: Allowed `aspect_ratio` values, e.g. "16:9". Empty when not selectable.

durations.description: Allowed `duration` values in seconds. Empty when the model does not take this parameter.

generateAudio.description: Whether `generate_audio` is available on this model.

resolutions.description: Allowed `resolution` values, e.g. "720p". Empty when not selectable.

seed.description: Whether `seed` is available on this model.

title: Get model pricing
